page.layout: One block of text in the centre-right of the page, with a printed page number above its first line; below the text, a closing word DIXI in spaced capitals, then a woodcut ornament (no text). No margin notes.

main_text.p: authoribus construet ftyli favos, quibus edulari folent, & condiri, afpera illa fublimioris doctrinæ monita, & abftrufa rarioris fapientiæ arcana ô fapientem, qui hîc fapit! qui ad hanc fegetem venit, manipulos frugum colligit, & in ufum fuum recondit ! Ut in Pandoram illam Poëticam omnia munera Deorum collata fuiffe ferunt: ita in hunc conspirâsse dicetis omnium Musarum Veneres, omnium authorum elegantias, omnem Suadæ venustatem nunquam perituram, quamdiu literis Romanis honos erit, aut vita !

page.notes: The page number "20" is printed small and raised above the first line. "DIXI." is set in spaced capitals and is treated as a closing word. The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. Some words in the line "ita in hunc conspirâsse" and "Pandoram" are as printed; the word "fuiffe" is printed with long s forms rendered as plain s. The first word of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page.
